title: Ty's couple, together

dates.source: Ty specified this window. Availability and price still come from Staff at run time.

turns.guest: Hi, there are two of us, Alex and Sam. We want to stay together, same room, from 5 November to 15 November 2027.
must: treat together as an explicit same-room requirement for the whole stay
call availability and room tools for the full stay
not place the guests, and not silently split them
must_not: book before the guest accepts a same-room option
hardcode Room 7 or Room 10 as the only winners

turns.when_stock: at least one room has two beds free for every night of the stay
turns.expected_offer: both beds in Room 7 or both beds in Room 10, same room, whole stay
must: quote the accepted selection with Staff Pricing
hold every requested bed or none
store and show the Staff total, deposit, and remaining amount

pass: same room for the whole stay, correct person-to-bed mapping, Staff total
fail: invented success when no same-room stock exists
